craft_notes: Sthāyin: Vismaya at unknowable workings, settling into plea. Capital→lower easing second question (ascent softens). Rejected: 'shard' for 'splinter' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Fine though thou be, how is tri-world thy splinter?
gross though thou be, why do Firstborn and kin miss thee plain?
l4.sanskrit_cite: sūkṣmo 'pi cet trilokīyaṃ kalāmātraṃ kathaṃ tava sthūlo 'tha kiṃ sudarśo na brahmādibhir api prabho

reads_against.argmap: If even subtle, how is this three-world a mere part of you? → Subtle yet whole-part; gross yet unseen — how?
c1_essence: Subtle yet whole, gross yet unseen; word-nets toiled in vain without you-as-expressible.

l2.plain_english: Subtle though you be, how is this triple world a mere fragment of yours? Gross though you be, why do even Brahmā and the rest not plainly see you, O lord?
l2.sanskrit_cite: sūkṣmo 'pi cet trilokīyaṃ kalāmātraṃ kathaṃ tava sthūlo 'tha kiṃ sudarśo na brahmādibhir api prabho
